label: illustrative
notes: ILLUSTRATIVE. A checker whose verdict FLIPS PASS/FAIL on re-run of the same input (verdict_stability flapping). Its rates are otherwise decent (one missed defect in 20 = 0.05, false_positive_rate 0.10), but a coin-flip verdict cannot be trusted or reproduced, so FLAPPING_VERDICT forces UNRELIABLE / red. The single miss is separately surfaced as an ANY_MISS warning.
